The vendor directly providing the software product **EmailWritr** at **emailwritr.com** is **EmailWritr LLC**.

### Supporting Evidence & Citation
* **Operating Company:** According to the legal terms/return and refund policy on `emailwritr.com`:
  > *"Company (referred to as either “the Company”, “We”, “Us” or “Our” in this Agreement) refers to EmailWritr LLC, 1309 Coffeen Avenue STE 1200, Sheridan, Wyoming, Wyoming 82801 US"* with *"Website refers to My Site, accessible from https://emailwritr.com"*.
* **Leadership / Founders:** The company was founded by Peter Onwe (Founder & CEO) alongside Augustine Esheya (Co-Founder) and Kevin Chukwu (CTO).
